decision_rule: retire without retuning if sparse, sub-cost, negative, unstable, or winner-dependent; official opens only after >=60 one-slot trades and positive PF/NAV/winner-reroute in each pre-2024 year at 18/24bp

event.bpr: exact overlap of raid FVG and later opposing FVG after close through raid origin
event.entry: first later BPR touch must close back out in second-displacement direction
event.external_pools: previous completed UTC-day high/low and midpoint
event.genuine_fvg: three-candle strict gap; middle body >= prior-only ATR20; gap >=0.05 prior-only ATR20

invalidation: hard raid-to-BPR extreme or completed 5m close through far BPR edge
logic: external-liquidity raid failure, opposing genuine-FVG overlap BPR, first-return rejection releases trapped raid-direction inventory
